`enum OverflowProperty`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.property` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [OverflowProperty.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/property/OverflowProperty.java)

What a node does with the children that go past its bounds.

## Learn more

- [Layout](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/layout/#clip-what-goes-beyond-a-node)
- [Flex layout](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/flex-layout/)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`SCROLL`](#OverflowProperty-value-SCROLL) | The children are clipped to the bounds, and the wheel or a scrollbar scrolls them. |
| [`HIDDEN`](#OverflowProperty-value-HIDDEN) | The children are clipped to the bounds of the node. |
| [`NONE`](#OverflowProperty-value-NONE) | The children are drawn and receive the input past the bounds. |

## Value details

<a id="OverflowProperty-value-SCROLL"></a>

### SCROLL

`SCROLL` 

The children are clipped to the bounds, and the wheel or a scrollbar scrolls them.

<a id="OverflowProperty-value-HIDDEN"></a>

### HIDDEN

`HIDDEN` 

The children are clipped to the bounds of the node.

<a id="OverflowProperty-value-NONE"></a>

### NONE

`NONE` 

The children are drawn and receive the input past the bounds.
